thesis: Advanced 2.5D/3D semiconductor packaging capacity utilization is projected to reach 94% in 2026E, driving revenue up 30.8% YoY to NT$ 89,500M. The demand surge in HPC chips utilizing CoWoS-like architecture, with bonding yields reaching 92.5%, reinforces high-margin order dominance.

High-margin advanced packaging revenue share rises from 38% in 2024 to 57% in 2026E, expanding overall gross margin by 5.7 ppt to 57.2%. Following Q3 qualification of proprietary silicon interposers, unit bill-of-materials costs decrease by 14.2%, driving structural profitability enhancement.

Free cash flow turns positive in 2025E to NT$ 12,400M as capex normalizes from 45% of revenue to 26%. A robust balance sheet supports sustained R&D. We project 2026E EPS of NT$ 51.00, implying a 12.2x P/E ratio versus peer average of 19.5x, offering significant rerating upside.

valuation.sensitivity: Based on 2026E EPS of NT$ 51.00, P/E multiples of 14.0x–19.0x yield a fair value range of NT$ 714 to NT$ 969.

valuation.result: Fair Value NT$ 885.00, offering 42.7% margin of safety
valuation.sensitivity: Assuming WACC of 8.5% and terminal growth rate of 2.5%; WACC sensitivity of ±0.5% spans NT$ 810 to NT$ 960.
